initial_observation.title: Lowsail Checkpoint
initial_observation.text: Sava lifts the chain for your council mark; redirect the next surge at Red Sluice.

observation.title: Lowsail Checkpoint
observation.text: Sava honors your charter, opening the Authority Path at Lowsail Levee. The chain stands open; Sava directs you to the Authority Path at Lowsail Levee.
observation.result: Sava honors your charter, opening the Authority Path at Lowsail Levee.

observation.title: Lowsail Levee
observation.text: You move along the connected path. The levee road runs east to Red Sluice. Workers brace the wet embankment.
observation.result: You move along the connected path.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: You move along the connected path. Nessa offers two clay and one mesh for plugs or screening; optional work uses tide steps. Plugs unlock Lowsail's three-coin sorting job after the tide; screening saves two stamina loading freight.
observation.result: You move along the connected path.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: Nessa hands over two clay and one mesh, enough for one product. Two clay and one mesh: plugs unlock three-coin sorting after Lowsail's tide; screening saves two stamina locally.
observation.result: Nessa hands over two clay and one mesh, enough for one product.

observation.title: Fume Yards Kiln Bay
observation.text: You move along the connected path. Two clay, one mesh, fuel, and wet screening fire a filter. Oren pays four coins; Brann's filter saves two stamina.
observation.result: You move along the connected path.

observation.title: Fume Yards Kiln Bay
observation.text: Pera hands over her only water cask. Fit Wet Screen consumes it to protect this firing. Two clay, one mesh, fuel, and wet screening fire a filter. Oren pays four coins; Brann's filter saves two stamina.
observation.result: Pera hands over her only water cask. Fit Wet Screen consumes it to protect this firing.

observation.title: Fume Yards Kiln Bay
observation.text: Brann hands over one fuel. Fired batches become ready after two steps and spoil after five. Two clay, one mesh, fuel, and wet screening fire a filter. Oren pays four coins; Brann's filter saves two stamina.
observation.result: Brann hands over one fuel. Fired batches become ready after two steps and spoil after five.

observation.title: Fume Yards Kiln Bay
observation.text: You prepare two clay and one mesh for firing. Reclaim Charge can still turn it into repair plugs. Ignite spends charge and fuel; its step counts toward readiness at two and spoilage at five.
observation.result: You prepare two clay and one mesh for firing. Reclaim Charge can still turn it into repair plugs.

observation.title: Fume Yards Kiln Bay
observation.text: You spend the water cask wetting the kiln screen. This protects one firing; the water cannot serve Lowsail. Ignite spends charge and fuel; its step counts toward readiness at two and spoilage at five.
observation.result: You spend the water cask wetting the kiln screen. This protects one firing; the water cannot serve Lowsail.

observation.title: Fume Yards Kiln Bay
observation.text: You light the batch; it becomes ready next step and spoils after four more. Bank to preserve the three-coin freight commission. Wait for the filter, or bank to save freight; spoilage loses the filter and three-coin commission.
observation.result: You light the batch; it becomes ready next step and spoils after four more. Bank to preserve the three-coin freight commission.

observation.title: Fume Yards Kiln Bay
observation.text: You bank the firebox and lose the loaded batch. Banking preserves the three-coin freight commission; no fuel returns. Your batch was banked; Brann's remaining kiln freight pays three coins and costs two stamina.
observation.result: You bank the firebox and lose the loaded batch. Banking preserves the three-coin freight commission; no fuel returns.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: You move along the connected path. Nessa's clay and mesh are spent; her remaining freight job pays two coins and costs two stamina.
observation.result: You move along the connected path.

observation.title: Lowsail Levee
observation.text: You move along the connected path. The levee road runs east to Red Sluice. Workers brace the wet embankment.
observation.result: You move along the connected path.

observation.title: Red Sluice Floor
observation.text: The charter opens the guarded Sluice path. Water pounds the lower gate. Edrik holds a broken gauge above the intake.
observation.result: The charter opens the guarded Sluice path.

observation.title: Red Sluice Top
observation.text: You move along the connected path. Mira waits beside the control wheels. A hot service ladder climbs into steam.
observation.result: You move along the connected path.

observation.title: Red Sluice Top
observation.text: The market stays dry while the upland works lose water. This surge is settled; choose Return to Lowsail to see the result.
observation.result: The market stays dry while the upland works lose water.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: You return to Lowsail's changed market. Oren, Sava, and Mira survey dry Lowsail while the upland works lose their water.
observation.result: You return to Lowsail's changed market.

observation.title: Lowsail Return
observation.text: You enforce council control while the upland works absorb the loss. Oren, Sava, and Mira survey dry Lowsail while the upland works lose their water.
observation.result: You enforce council control while the upland works absorb the loss.

observation.title: Fume Yards Workshop
observation.text: You follow the raised road to Nessa's workshop. Nessa's clay and mesh are spent; her remaining freight job pays two coins and costs two stamina.
observation.result: You follow the raised road to Nessa's workshop.

observation.title: Fume Yards Kiln Bay
observation.text: You move along the connected path. Your batch was banked; Brann's remaining kiln freight pays three coins and costs two stamina.
observation.result: You move along the connected path.

observation.title: Fume Yards Kiln Bay
observation.text: You load kiln freight and clear dust, spending two stamina. Brann pays three coins; his only freight job is finished. Brann's kiln freight is finished; the spent firebox remains closed.
observation.result: You load kiln freight and clear dust, spending two stamina. Brann pays three coins; his only freight job is finished.
